plugins.name: learning-with-court
plugins.description: Entry point for the learning-with-court catalog of hands-on technical workshops. After install, tell Claude Code 'set up the mcp workshop' and the plugin runs @learning-with-court/cli to sign you in (one-time browser flow), clone the workshop into ~/learning-with-court/<id>/, and hand you off to a fresh Claude Code session. Lessons are driven by the workshop's deployed MCP server, not by this plugin.
